column1: # FP-KV.tsv FP-CONVERGE-KV 11-25 iteration it2 (09:1x PST) on plan A5t8 cut1 sha 6cd026683af9 (read-only copy of epyc12 kv-allfix/a5t8/final/A5t8.json). Cell = FAIL:<n> or pass; STREET cell = worst lane demand (>1.0 fails). Tools: plan_advisory (all checks, no tree) + precheck.py (--die qwen_kvsys, no tree) on rt 031e61512813 (includes street model 6d3b0bd722f, FT-CROSSES-CORE, SITE-IN-MACRO); RSTREACH from gate_A5t8/pre.log (plan-only PRE, rt 65957f66ecee, same plan sha). Outputs: epyc8 /srv/opentallas-scratch2/claude/FP-CONVERGE-KV/it2/{adv2.out,pc2/findings.tsv}.

# COLUMNS: names match lanes/LAUNCH-GATE-RULES.tsv exactly (STREET, REACH, TAP-CAP, CORE-TAP-OWNER, MISAIM, SITE-IN-MACRO, BOUNDARY-REG, LEG405, OVERSIZE); MISAIM 0 findings on A5t8. SITE-IN-MACRO now proven-blocking (774b3c7f2).

# CAVEATS: (1) TAP-ERR=ERR on 45 types: precheck without the plan tree cannot resolve hard-core pin tables (ResetError), so TAP-CAP/TAP-COVER are NOT censused there; TAP-CAP fails only on 3 types (io_cor 1401, io_cor_v1 1063, pv_v6 1114), none >5000. (2) HOLDCELL-BUDGET not run: no hold cache (adv_harvest_hold.py needed). (3) R8STALE is per table, not per type: 4 WARN tables in pre.log (r8_k3f 1349 members/475 lanes, vport 4, pv_col_pads 168, pv_v_pads 604); gate bind1 had 31 R8_STALE errors, R8_REFRESH at 16:25Z rewrote 190 members (A5t8 gate still running, so the post-refresh state is not yet in this table). (4) OVERSIZE kv3_pc_v3 998k is a stale plan key per ALLFIX L231. (5) LEG405 = ADV-LEG405-ZERO findings, REACH = precheck REACH hops (>300); both advisory. VISUAL pending the A5t8 render.

# TREND (types failing any class / street>1.0 / oversize / overlap / ft-crosses-core / boundary-reg): it0 A5t7 -/33/1/0/-/- ; it1 A5t8 89/23/1/0/-/- ; it2 A5t8 85/40/1/0/78/53. STREET 23->40 is the new street model (core interiors zero capacity), not a plan change. ; it3 (tree-backed) 85/40/1/0/78/53, TAP-CAP 17, CORE-FACE-GAP 52, CELLCAP 10

# OWNERS (ALLFIX-KV rows): STREET -> STREET-LANE-DEMAND (KV-ALLFIX+KV-OWN-PV-R2+KV-OWN-HG-R2, DEFERRED A5t9); BOUNDARY-REG -> FP-BOUNDARY-49 (KV-OWN-HUB-R2) + FP-COREOWNER-HG; CORE-TAP-OWNER -> FP-COREOWNER-HG; LEG405/REACH -> SYSC-LEG405 (KV-ALLFIX), PCBANK-LEGS (KV-PC-BANK), C9-KVPV-CLAND-LEG (KV-OWN-PV-R2); RSTREACH -> RSTREACH leftovers (KV-PV-ESTRIP); SITE-IN-MACRO -> SITE-OFF-OUTLINE (KV-OWN-HG-R2 + KV-OWN-PV-R2); OVERSIZE -> PC-V3-OVERSIZE (KV-PC-BANK); TAP drift -> ADDED-TAPS-REDERIVE (FP-CONVERGE-KV, DEFERRED A5t9). NO ROW FOUND: FT-CROSSES-CORE (78 types, new class), TAP-CAP 3 types (io_cor, io_cor_v1, pv_v6), R8STALE tables -> proposed to KV-ALLFIX.

# VISUAL (it2, 11-25 09:5x PST): Fable reviews of the VISUAL-QUEUE probe renders (place layout/density; smells 4 of 6 not computable on big DBs): 23 types FAIL, all problems in lanes/FP-KV-VISUAL.tsv (n_problems = count in the reviewer reports). Cell FAIL-A5t8-review:N = reviewed, N problems; other types keep FAIL-A5t7-render. Common causes: macros/landings sited in streets and off pin faces; cross-half/centre piles with no station rows; core rows off-centre in streets; unstationed long nets (fanout 1400-2400 um); pv/hg/pc types over the 400k cap (pc_v1 468k, pv_v1n 827k, hg_v1p5 405k).

# IT3 (tree-backed): precheck.py run in place on the epyc12 A5t8 tree with its own tools (TAP-ERROR 45 -> 0, so TAP is now censused on all 93 types): TAP-CAP now FAIL on 17 types (it2 said 3; worst hub_C 4462, hgi_v1 cl42bc 2041; none over the 5000 blocking line). Columns TAP-ERR dropped. New report-only classes (COORD 10:0x): CORE-FACE-GAP = hard core to outline < 35 um on a face with pins, or < 100 um where >= 20 port-bank sites sit in that strip (plan-only, approximate: a face counts as pinned if any bus/ft_slot uses it); CELLCAP = type over 400k instances (plan cells key where it exceeds, else the post-place instance count from the render reviews; pc_v3 plan 998k is a stale key, real GRT count 502,917 per ALLFIX L231). LAUNCH-GATE-RULES takes its rule names from these columns. HOLDCELL-BUDGET still not run. VISUAL cell FAIL-A5t8-review:N = Fable-agent review of the probe render, N problems, details lanes/FP-KV-VISUAL.tsv (23 types).

# HOLDCELL (it3b, 10:5x PST): ADV-HOLDCELL-BUDGET run on A5t8 with a hold cache harvested on epyc10 (40 kits, 24 types) and epyc12 (2 kits); epyc8 and epyc11 harvests did not finish (epyc11 ssh reset). Check result: 33 types measured, 58 no retained kit (read pass-or-no-kit, not proven pass), 11 over 5% pad share, 11 with open port endpoints, 22 flagged lines. Flagged = planned-pad share >= 5% (HB4 per zero-logic pair) or port-open endpoints; the pc family shows 8.4% (36k pad cells of 429k insts) -> use lockup / tap co-location (KV-HOLD-STRUCT rows L719-L721 and L680-L707).
